name: Spatial Scale Spectrum
author: PointillViz reference tools
description: How clustered each cell type is, at every length scale.
citation: Torquato, S. (2018). Hyperuniform states of matter. Physics Reports 745, 1-95.

params.name: field
params.label: Grouping column
params.help:
Selects the annotation used to define the populations.
Defaults to the dataset’s cell-type column.

params.name: focus
params.label: Population to map
params.help:
Selects the population shown in the map.
This does not change the plot or table.
Defaults to the most abundant population that meets the minimum cell count.

params.name: min_cells
params.label: Minimum cells per population
params.help: Sets the minimum number of cells required for a population to receive its own table row and spectrum.

params.name: grid
params.label: Binning resolution
params.help:
Sets the G × G grid used for the Fourier transform.
Higher resolutions can show shorter wavelengths but require more memory and runtime.

params.name: real_space
params.label: Real-space check
params.help:
Also measures cell-count variation in spatial windows as an independent check on the spectrum.
This adds Var / Var_null and alpha to the table.

params.name: n_perms
params.label: Null permutations
params.help: Sets how many random label redistributions are used to estimate the grey null band.
